claimBoundary.provesIfPasses: Benchmark-scoped evidence that the real GPT-2 live pipeline can discover selected attention heads and MLP nodes for factual prompts, then validate an ordered attention->residual->MLP->target path by showing selected attention interventions change selected MLP activations above full-control path interventions while the combined circuit remains causally effective on the target logit.
